description: Traffic Signal Sites is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. The location of electronic traffic signals, designed, owned and or controlled and maintained by Main Roads Western Australia, that control vehicle and pedestrian traffic at an intersection or on a road are identified in this data set. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are Road Assets, open data. It offers 8 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
